items.q: Hypercalcaemia from PTHrP secretion most characteristically complicates which lung cancer?
items.exp: Squamous cell lung cancers secrete parathyroid hormone related protein causing humoral hypercalcaemia with suppressed PTH. Small cell cancers instead cause SIADH and ACTH syndromes.
r: Incorrect. Adenocarcinoma is known for driver mutations and pleural spread.
Correct. Squamous cancer secretes PTHrP.
Incorrect. Small cell causes SIADH and Cushing syndromes.
Incorrect. Carcinoid may cause flushing syndromes, not this classic pairing.
items.kp: Lung cancer plus high calcium: squamous plus PTHrP.

items.q: Hyponatraemia from ectopic ADH (SIADH) most strongly pairs with which tumour?
items.exp: Small cell carcinoma secretes ADH causing concentrated urine with dilute serum (SIADH) and ACTH causing Cushing syndrome. These neuroendocrine secretions define its paraneoplastic profile.
r: Incorrect. Squamous secretes PTHrP instead.
Correct. Small cell secretes ADH.
Incorrect. Adenocarcinoma lacks this classic secretion.
Incorrect. Mesothelioma follows asbestos with pleural disease.
items.kp: Small cell secretions: ADH down sodium, ACTH up cortisol.

items.q: Shoulder pain, Horner syndrome and wasting of hand muscles localise a tumour where?
items.exp: Apical Pancoast tumours invade first ribs, sympathetic chain (Horner syndrome) and lower brachial plexus (ulnar hand wasting). Most are non small cell, often adenocarcinoma or squamous.
r: Incorrect. Basal tumours cause effusion and diaphragmatic signs.
Correct. Apex invasion causes this triad.
Incorrect. Nodes alone cause vena caval or airway compression.
Incorrect. Diffuse pleural disease suggests mesothelioma.
items.kp: Apex tumour plus Horner plus hand wasting equals Pancoast.

items.q: Commonest lung cancer in non smokers and women, arising peripherally, is what?
items.exp: Adenocarcinoma predominates in non smokers and women, arises in peripheral lung from glandular epithelium and frequently carries EGFR, ALK or KRAS alterations guiding therapy.
r: Incorrect. Squamous is central and strongly smoking linked.
Correct. Peripheral adenocarcinoma leads in non smokers.
Incorrect. Small cell is almost exclusively a smokers cancer centrally.
Incorrect. Large cell is uncommon and poorly differentiated.
items.kp: Non smoker peripheral cancer: adenocarcinoma first.

items.q: Lambert Eaton syndrome complicating small cell cancer differs from myasthenia gravis how?
o: Strength improves briefly with activity and reflexes are reduced
items.exp: Lambert Eaton antibodies block presynaptic calcium channels, so brief activity transiently improves release and strength, with autonomic dryness and reduced reflexes. Myasthenia fatigues with use and targets postsynaptic receptors.
r: Incorrect. Fatigability defines myasthenia instead.
Correct. Improvement with activity marks Lambert Eaton.
Incorrect. Proximal leg weakness dominates over ocular signs.
Incorrect. Receptor antibodies define myasthenia gravis.
items.kp: Improves with use equals Lambert Eaton; fatigues equals myasthenia.

items.q: Keratin pearls and intercellular bridges on biopsy indicate which carcinoma?
items.exp: Squamous differentiation produces keratin pearls and intercellular bridges (desmosomes), usually in central bronchi of smokers with cavitation. Glands and mucin would indicate adenocarcinoma.
r: Incorrect. Adenocarcinoma forms glands and mucin.
Correct. Keratin pearls mean squamous carcinoma.
Incorrect. Small cells show moulding and scant cytoplasm without keratin.
Incorrect. Carcinoid shows neuroendocrine organoid nests.
items.kp: Keratin pearls in lung mean squamous carcinoma.

items.q: Why is surgery rarely curative in small cell lung cancer?
o: Micrometastases are present at diagnosis in most patients
It arises only in operable peripheral sites
items.exp: Small cell cancer doubles rapidly and disseminates microscopically before detection, so systemic chemotherapy anchors treatment. Very limited stage exceptions may add surgery or chemoradiation.
r: Incorrect. It is initially highly chemosensitive.
Correct. Early micrometastases defeat local surgery.
Incorrect. It is usually central with bulky nodes.
Incorrect. Radiation helps limited stage but does not cure alone broadly.
items.kp: Small cell is systemic at birth: chemotherapy first.

items.q: Pleural plaques and diffuse pleural thickening decades after asbestos exposure suggest which malignancy?
items.exp: Mesothelioma arises from pleural mesothelium after asbestos latency of decades, encasing lung with effusion and chest pain, distinct from parenchymal lung cancers though asbestos also raises those risks.
r: Incorrect. Adenocarcinoma is parenchymal, not pleural encasing.
Correct. Asbestos latency plus pleural encasement means mesothelioma.
Incorrect. Small cell is central bronchial in smokers.
Incorrect. Thymoma is anterior mediastinal with myasthenia links.
items.kp: Asbestos plus pleural encasement equals mesothelioma.

items.q: Superior vena cava obstruction from mediastinal lung cancer causes which sign pattern?
o: Facial and upper limb swelling worse on bending or lying flat
items.exp: Blocked vena cava congests the head, neck and arms with distended veins and periorbital swelling worsened by lying flat. Pemberton sign and urgent staging guide relief by stenting or oncological therapy.
r: Incorrect. Leg swelling suggests iliac or caval lower obstruction.
Correct. Upper body congestion worse flat means SVC obstruction.
Incorrect. Ascites suggests portal or peritoneal disease.
Incorrect. Hoarseness alone suggests recurrent laryngeal involvement.
items.kp: Cannot lie flat with swollen face: check the vena cava.

items.q: EGFR mutation testing most changes management in which lung cancer group?
items.exp: EGFR, ALK and related driver testing in non small cell (especially adenocarcinoma) selects targeted tyrosine kinase therapies with major survival benefit. Small cell management remains chemotherapy based.
r: Incorrect. Small cell lacks these routine targeted drivers.
Correct. Adenocarcinoma profiling selects targeted drugs.
Incorrect. Mesothelioma uses different regimens and markers.
Incorrect. Carcinoid therapy centres on surgery and somatostatin pathways.
items.kp: Profile adenocarcinoma genes before choosing first line therapy.
